## Diverging Signals
- **Price versus credit.** Stocks bounced hard on Nov 23 (NDX +6.86%, TQQQ +19.17%), but HY and IG OAS were wider on Nov 20 and have not been refreshed. If credit stays wide while price bounces, the bounce is less trustworthy.
- **VIX versus VXN.** VXN fell −19.76% to 36.31, while VIX rose +6.42% to 28.33 on Nov 24. These are different dates, and the Nov 24 VIX print may be an early read on a new day. VIX/VIX3M at 1.042 on Nov 23 says near-dated fear eased, but the Nov 24 VIX rise says it has not gone away.
- **News score versus price.** The news engine score rose to 16.1 (SHOCK) even as price bounced. A circuit-breaker headline and a recovery headline sit side by side. Gap risk is two-way.
- **Implication:** a 19% one-day TQQQ gain after a 15.94% fall means the realised swings are huge in both directions. A bounce this size inside a Stage 5 backdrop is a common feature of unstable regimes, not proof of a bottom.
